Original_Text: Diabetes, dyslipidemia, hypertension, high total cholesterol, and heart disease were each associated with higher odds of medical non-readiness.
Limited_Text: In the Paraná cross-sectional occupational cohort, the listed conditions were associated with higher modeled odds of medical non-readiness.
Evidence_Boundary: The cross-sectional Paraná cohort reports associations with medical non-readiness, not causal effects.

Original_Text: The nine Core records span seven substantive domains: two nutrition/shift-work studies; two firearm-performance publications from a partially overlapping cadet family; one operational tourniquet-use study; two policy/program evaluations; one academy-fitness study; and one medical-readiness cohort.
Limited_Text: The frozen Core record set spans the stated domains; source depth and claim scope differ across records, and the two firearm publications belong to one partially overlapping cohort family.
Evidence_Boundary: The source packets document the named evidence domains, but the inventory includes abstract-only and source-insufficient records.

Original_Text: Os nove registros Core abrangem nutrição/turnos, duas publicações sobre tiro oriundas de uma família parcialmente sobreposta, uso operacional de torniquete, avaliação de política de policiamento, resultado nulo de programa escolar, aptidão em academia e prontidão médica.
Limited_Text: O conjunto congelado inclui registros nesses domínios; a força da evidência varia por desenho, fonte e população.
Evidence_Boundary: The frozen inventory documents the domains, with heterogeneous source depth.
